outcome: Causes of severe acute maternal morbidity (SAMM) and maternal near miss (NM)
Risk factors for SAMM and NM
cohort: 300 pregnant women, including 269 diagnosed with SAMM and 31 diagnosed with NM
finding: Women with low education status, multiparity, third trimester and postpartum period, suboptimal antenatal visits, and a lack of awareness were at increased risk of SAMM and NM.
mod_finding: This study analyzing causes of severe acute maternal morbidity and maternal near miss did not specifically investigate mode of delivery as a risk factor.
